question: Face-to-face interactions promote ___________ problem-solving and stronger teamwork.
solution:
The correct answer is '**Quick**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• According to the passage, "**Face to face interactions promote quick problem-solving...**" which directly identifies the correct word.
 
• The word "**quick**" is an adjective used here to describe the speed and efficiency of solving problems in an in-person setting.
 
• While other options relate to time, "**Quick**" is the specific term used in the text to contrast with the difficulty of virtual replication.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Complete Sentence:** *"Face-to-face interactions promote **quick**__ problem-solving and stronger teamwork."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "Brief"** refers to something short in duration but does not imply the speed of resolution.
 
• **Option 2: "Instant"** suggests something happening immediately, which is stronger than what the text describes.
 
• **Option 4: "Sudden"** implies something unexpected or without warning, which is contextually inappropriate for problem-solving.
